 Mizoram govt hikes DA, approves regularisation of long-serving contract staff
 PTI 
 17 November, 2026 06:47 pm IST 
 Follow Us:

 Aizawl, Nov 17 (PTI) The Mizoram government on Tuesday announced a four percentage-point hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) for its employees, raising it from 46 per cent to 50 per cent with effect from December 1, an official said.
 The decision was taken at a cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Lalduhoma here, he said.
 The cabinet also approved doubling the DA for contractual employees from 10 per cent to 20 per cent, effective December 1.
 Show Full Article
 The government hiked DA for its employees from 36 per cent to 44 per cent in November last year, followed by a further increase to 46 per cent with effect from April 1 this year.
 In another major decision, the cabinet approved the regularisation of contractual employees who have completed more than 10 years of service and provisional employees who have served for over 14 years, the official said.
 The meeting also approved the withdrawal of an earlier decision to privatise the Mizoram Food and Allied Industries Corporation (MIFCO) Ltd, and cleared the fresh prerequisite conditions for the provincialisation of schools.
 It further approved the upgradation of the pay level of District Fisheries Development Officers from Level 10A to Level 11 and the restructuring of posts under the Directorate of Commerce and Industries.
 The cabinet also cleared draft guidelines for the engagement of provisional employees, a scheme to engage state-sponsored MBBS graduates to fulfil their bond obligations and the draft Mizoram Local Rice Procurement Policy, 2026, among other proposals. PTI CORR SOM
